feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 2 (score 433) and iteration 3 (score 449) show that the oval is now solved (20 of 20 finishes, max_error about 0.025) and that the s-bend is limited by line loss at the 0.06 m floor, not by jitter (oscillation 0.30 to 0.32). Iteration 3 narrowed wheel_track to 0.09 and raised the s-bend progress to 0.68, but slalom line losses rose from 1.0 (iteration 2) to 1.85, with progress 0.17. That pattern points to the 12 mm footprint being too narrow to hold the line through alternating bends, so the 16 mm footprint is the right next test. Expected behaviour, not measured: the slalom should fall back toward 1.0 losses, and the s-bend may drop below 1.0 losses. The footprint change also blurs the edge signal, so the s-bend may not improve and the oval may show more oscillation. Read the next race as follows. If slalom line_loss_events return to about 1.0 or below and s-bend max_error drops below 0.06 on some seeds, keep sensor_size 0.016. If the slalom recovers but the s-bend still sits at the floor with low oscillation, the geometry is near its limit and the next gain should come from the controller, not from more geometry. If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35 on the s-bend or oval, the blurred edge signal is the likely cause, so return to 0.012 and try an intermediate track or pitch change instead.
requested_changes: If the slalom line_loss_events return to about 1.0 or below and the s-bend stays at 1.0 losses with max_error at the 0.06 floor, keep sensor_size 0.016 and try wheel_track 0.085 (within the 0.08 minimum) for more turn authority, since iteration 3 showed the s-bend at 0.68 progress on 0.09 m.

If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35 on the s-bend or oval with sensor_size 0.016, return to sensor_size 0.012 and keep wheel_track 0.09, since iteration 3 gave oscillation 0.32 on the s-bend and 0.21 on the oval.

If slalom line losses stay near 1.85 with sensor_size 0.016, the footprint is not the cause, so test sensor y 0.075 with the same x positions, since iteration 2 at y 0.07 gave slalom losses of 1.0 and oval finishes of 20 of 20.
